name: Planar Partial-Cube Expansion and Jordan Representation Equivalence
statement: Non-crossing two-face expansion sequences and non-separating Jordan-curve arrangements define exactly the planar partial cubes. In a plane partial cube the dual cycles of the Theta-class bonds give the curves; conversely non-separation supplies the cut-partition path property.
proof: A planar Theta-class is a bond and dualizes to a simple dual cycle. Intersections of semicubes containing one fixed vertex are convex and connected, which gives non-separation. Conversely, failure of the partial-cube cut-partition path criterion would yield selected curve sides whose union disconnects the required complement. The corrected planar expansion theorem supplies the equivalent constructive presentation.
